scope_evidence.source_description: Audit and manage dependencies across multi-language projects. Identifies vulnerabilities, license conflicts, transitive dependency risks, and safe-upgrade paths. Use when auditing third-party packages before release, investigating a CVE, planning a major version bump, or running a license-compliance review. plan.acceptance: Candidate must select every current reference at >=0.7 and retain every current/later reference throughout all seven cases. Cost preference applies only among all-pass arms. All semantic failures remain; no retries, tuning or passed-need replay.
plan.token_cap: Check before dispatch; one response may cross it. Stop on transport, missing usage, malformed output or exhausted budget.
plan.limitations: One known failure and six author-written combinations, one pass without independent blind review. The earlier stopping heuristic is calibrated from prior traces, not proven optimal. Selection only, no business execution or population accuracy claim.

limitations: One known failure and six author-written combinations, one pass without independent blind review. The earlier stopping heuristic is calibrated from prior traces, not proven optimal. Selection only, no business execution or population accuracy claim.
All failures remain in primary denominators. Two final-limit failures incur no final-model call, so their lower cost is not completion-equivalent savings.
Original missing target improves from .39 to .43 against the unchanged .4 threshold in this pass; its narrow margin and sampling variation do not establish universal stability.

The finance early_stop failure occurs without triggering the earlier stop. A .38/.41 directory-score variation retains six extra members. The exact saved-request replay is offline analysis, not a new live pass or an additional accuracy sample.

The three-arm comparison isolates description repair from the cost-stop parameter in source, but independently sampled directory responses still differ. One pass is not independent blind validation or a stable latency claim.

Only Jev selector time and reported tokens are measured. Root reasoning and intent-entry cost, complete business-task cost, backend model revision and monetary charges are unobservable in these metrics.

At verification all 354 release/configuration files, 232 main-worktree files and 224 lifecycle-worktree files, their HEADs and Git status match the fresh start snapshots. These are time-bounded observations.
No installation, activation, private-catalog mutation, lifecycle modification, business execution or network replay of passed needs.
